lines: lut demãder oncques ſeparatiõ de mariage pour raiſon
du malefice, auquel ſon mari auoit eſté retenu depuis
le mariage, neuf ans ou enuiron: cõbien que par la loy
des Pontifes, incontinent apres trois ans, luy fuſt loiſi-
ble requerir la ſeparation {a}. Pourquoy mieux enten-
dre faut ſçauoir, que l'emſpechement aux perſonnes, de
pouuoir cohabiter charnellement auec ſon pareil, pro
cede ou de froideur, ou d'enſorcellement, ou bien d'au
tre maniere d'impuiſſance {b}, qui eſt vne diction gene-
rale, par laquelle eſt ſignifié tout defaut de pouuoir
participer auec ſon pareil, ſoit par nature, ou par acci-
ſeulement du bas aage, {d} & ceſte cy eſt commune, tant
à l'homme qu'à la femme. Leſquels tandis qu'ils ſont
pupiles, c'eſt à dire, l'homme moindre de quatorze ans,
& la femme de douze, n'ont puiſſance (ſelon les com-
munes vertus de nature) d'exercer l'acte de la chair {e}.
& par ainſi ne ſont aptes à contracter mariage {f}. meſ-
mes que comme ci deſſus a eſté amplemẽt remonſtré {g})
ils n'ont encor ſens, ni iugement arreſté, pour bailler
conſentemẽt {h}. & bien que toute eſpece de crime, cõme
larrecin, ſacrilege, meurtre, pariure, & ſemblables, puiſſe
cheoir en eux: toutesfois, celuy de la chair, cõmunémẽt
n'y tombe point {i}: & voila pourquoy ne peuuent eſtre
accuſez d'adultere {k}. Quelquefois l'impuiſſance de na-
ture procede de froideur {l}, c'eſt à dire d'vne temperatu
re ſi froide, qu'elle ne ſe pourroit eſchauffer, ni accom-
moder à compagnie charnelle de femme {m} quelle que
ſoit: car l'homme eſt empeſché par froideur cognoi
ſtre vne femme, qui eſt empeſché auſſi de ſ'approcher
de toutes les autres {n}. Et ceſte eſpece d'impuiſſance ap-
partient au hommes ſeulement: ſuffiſante cauſe pour
empeſcher le mariage, qu'on eſt en traicté d'accorder,
& conſommer ou bien diſſoudre celuy qui ſeroit ia cõ-
tracté {o}: ou bien le declarer nul: d'autãt qu'à la verité, tel
Pline au liure xi. c. xxxvij.
c. requiſiſt. preallegué. Glo: au c. final de
c. i. c. ij. c. ex literis. c. laudabilem. c. fraternitatis.
de frig. & malef. c. i. c. requiſiſti. xxxiij. q i.

uncertain.note: page quality: this is a Gallica microfilm frame, hard-binarized to two tones. The body column is legible but pitted with stray specks and blots; the italic margin column is heavily over-inked and several citations are only partly recoverable. Every margin reading below carries more doubt than the body ones.

uncertain.text: lut demãder oncques ſeparatiõ de mariage pour raiſon
uncertain.note: the page opens mid-word; p040 is not yet transcribed, so the first word 'lut' is read as the tail of 'vou-|lut' from the sense ('ne voulut demander oncques ſeparation'), not from the preceding page.

uncertain.text: du malefice, auquel ſon mari auoit eſté retenu depuis
uncertain.note: a small irregular mark sits above the u of 'du'. Read as stray ink / show-through, not a tilde: 'dũ' is not a word, and the mark has none of the clean horizontal bar of the real macrons on this page ('cõbien', 'demãder').

uncertain.text: des Pontifes, incontinent apres trois ans, luy fuſt loiſi-
uncertain.note: a heavy blot sits above the n of 'incontinent'. At high magnification the n is fully formed under it, so the word is spelled out; read as a blot, not as 'incõtinent'.

uncertain.text: dre faut ſçauoir, que l'emſpechement aux perſonnes, de
uncertain.note: sic: the print sets the long s before the p — 'emſpechement', a transposition for 'empeſchement'. Verified at high magnification and confirmed by contrast with 'empeſcher' at blocks[0].lines[32], where the same word is set correctly.

uncertain.text: cede ou de froideur, ou d'enſorcellement, ou bien d'au
uncertain.note: a small slanted mark sits above the u of the line-final 'd'au'. Read as stray ink: 'd'au|tre' needs neither a tilde nor a break sign, and the mark sits higher and thinner than the printed hyphens on this page. Reader B may read 'd'aũ'.

uncertain.text: mes que comme ci deſſus a eſté amplemẽt remonſtré {g})
uncertain.note: the marker between 'remonſtré' and ')' is small and badly inked; read as {g} from the alphabet sequence (a…f precede it, i k l follow) and because the note keyed g, 'En l'anno-tatiõ premiere', matches 'comme ci deſſus a eſté amplement remonſtré'. Also sic: this ')' has no opening parenthesis — the pair opened on line 16 is already closed on line 17.

uncertain.text: conſentemẽt {h}. & bien que toute eſpece de crime, cõme
uncertain.note: the italic marker after 'conſentemẽt' reads like a 'b' in this scan, as does the matching key in the margin; read as {h} from the alphabet sequence (…f, g, this, i, k, l…). The h's right leg is closed up by ink in both places.

uncertain.text: cheoir en eux: toutesfois, celuy de la chair, cõmunémẽt
uncertain.note: an ink blot stands between 'toutesfois' and 'celuy'. Read as a comma: the blot carries a comma's descender and no letter is discernible.

uncertain.text: moder à compagnie charnelle de femme {m} quelle que
uncertain.note: the mark after 'femme' is a solid ink blot with no letter legible. Read as the marker {m}: the foot citation keyed m has no other marker anywhere on the page, the blot sits exactly where a marker would, and it is wider than tall, as an over-inked italic m would be.

uncertain.text: partient au hommes ſeulement: ſuffiſante cauſe pour
uncertain.note: sic: 'au hommes' for 'aux hommes'. No x is printed; checked at high magnification.

uncertain.text: tracté {o}: ou bien le declarer nul: d'autãt qu'à la verité, tel
uncertain.note: a small round glyph stands between 'tracté' and the colon. Read as the marker {o}: the foot citation keyed o has no other marker on the page, and o is the next letter after n (line 31). It could instead be read as a final 'e' ('tractée:'), though 'celuy... contracté' wants the masculine.

four line breaks are printed with no word-break hyphen and are transcribed as printed: lines[6] 'pro' + lines[7] 'cede'; lines[7] 'd'au' + lines[8] 'tre'; lines[25] 'temperatu' + lines[26] 're'; lines[28] 'cognoi' + lines[29] 'ſtre'. Hyphens are printed normally elsewhere ('loiſi-', 'enten-', 'cõ-'), so these are compositor omissions, not lost ink.

spacing: the compositor repeatedly sets a comma with no following space ('perſonnes,de', 'crime,cõme', 'larrecin,ſacrilege', 'nul:d'autãt', 'celuyqui') and sometimes a justification space before one ('nature ,', 'ſens ,', 'femme .'). All normalized to single spaces per §1; nothing is added or removed beyond spacing.

uncertain.text: c. final. de
uncertain.note: uncertain whether a point is printed after 'final'; the same citation in foot note n reads 'au c. final de' with none. The mark may be a speck.

uncertain.text: bi, qui xxxiij.
uncertain.note: the canon's name breaks oddly across lines ('Gloſe au c. | bi, qui'); 'bi' is clear but the mark after it could be a point rather than a comma, and the intended canon title is not one I can identify.

uncertain.text: piuntur. D.
uncertain.note: a stray dot is printed between 'piuntur.' and 'D.', in the middle of the gap. Treated as an ink speck and omitted; reader B may transcribe it as a second point.

uncertain.text: c. requiſiſti. c.
uncertain.note: a low smudge stands between 'requiſiſti.' and the following 'c.'; no letter is legible and it is omitted.

uncertain.text: c. requiſiſt. preallegué. Glo: au c. final de
uncertain.note: 'Glo:' — two dots are stacked after 'Glo', so a colon is transcribed; it could be a point with a speck above it. 'requiſiſt.' is abbreviated here where the margin (note l) and foot note o both give 'requiſiſti'.

uncertain.text: de frig. & malef. c. i. c. requiſiſti. xxxiij. q i.
uncertain.note: no point is printed after the final 'q' (or it is lost in the film); transcribed as printed. Elsewhere on the page the same formula is set 'q. i.' / 'q. j.'.

structure: the foot block is set as three full-width printed lines, not as three separate citations. Citation m occupies the left of printed line 1; n runs from the right of line 1 onto the left of line 2; o runs from the middle of line 2 through the whole of line 3. Recorded as one entry per citation per §4, so the entries' lines are the fragments belonging to each, not whole printed lines.

no signature and no catchword are printed. The leaf is blank from just below the foot block to the edge of the film (checked on the untrimmed source), so nothing is lost to the crop — but folio 41 would be the first leaf of gathering F, where a signature would be expected.

uncertain.text: PARLEMENT DE THOLOSE,
uncertain.note: the head is set in spaced capitals and is closed up here per the validator's §3 rule. It ends with a comma, not the point the conventions' example shows for rectos; the descender is clear at high magnification.

uncertain.text: ſtinien, de x[??].
uncertain.note: the word after 'de' is an x, then a tall letter with an ascender hooked left at the top (italic l or ſ) and a round blob, then a point: 'xis', 'xls', 'xiſ' all possible; the sense (Nov. 22, coll. iiij, de nuptiis) does not help with these glyphs. Pointer: pages/strips/p041/margin-1.jpg, note b, fourth line, y about 400-430 of 1314, right half of the line. | Carson-session 2026-09-21: at 4x the glyphs read x-i-s (three readers concur); best reading `xis.`; cross-check against the 1618 reprint text during translation review.

uncertain.text: l. minorem.
uncertain.note: ending over-inked; read 'em' (e + three-humped m), not 'um'.

uncertain.text: D. de ri. nup.
uncertain.note: the two letters between 'de' and the point are under a blot: an r-shaped glyph and a rounded blob. Read 'ri' (de ritu nuptiarum, the title of l. Minorem, as p004 prints 'L. minorem D. de rit. nup'); the second letter is not recoverable, and a 't' cannot be excluded.

uncertain.text: l. penul[...] deſ-
uncertain.note: struck through in manuscript ink on the leaf: one heavy curved pen stroke, not a printed rule, crosses this line and the next. Printed text read from what shows above the stroke: 'l. pe', the tops of 'nu', a clear l ascender; the letters between that l and 'deſ-' (about four, presumably 'time', cf. note d 'l. penultime.') are wholly covered and are not transcribed.

uncertain.text: ſ[...] alleguee.
uncertain.note: struck through in manuscript ink on the leaf (the same stroke). The italic long ſ at the start of the line is legible; the two letters after it are under the ink (presumably 'us', completing 'deſ-|ſus'); 'alleguee.' is clear.

uncertain.text: P. j de nup.
uncertain.note: no point is printed after 'j'; the single point stands between P and j.

note h is over-inked throughout. Its key letter is shaped like an italic b, as is the marker on blocks[0].lines[20]; both read h by sequence. 'l. i. C. de ſal.|mon.' is read letter by letter and does not resolve to a Code title I can identify; transcribed as it stands. lines[2] 'xxx. q. ij.': the numeral after 'q.' carries two dots and a j descender, the same form as '& ij.' on lines[1].

uncertain.text: tia. xxxiij. q. j.
uncertain.note: roman numerals in the margin are badly inked; the four 'xxxiij' (notes a, c, l and foot note o) are read as 33, consistent with the Gratian causa cited, but 'xxxiiij' cannot be excluded on this film.
